execution: Persistent dynamic parameters/JIT; official one-member rollout; retain official normalization, NaN/SST cleaning and inner autoregressive wrapper. Highest float32 matmul, TF32 disabled; unchanged weights and scoring.

validation_protocol.primary_reference: One fresh CPU rollout in the same pinned WSL runtime and inference code path
validation_protocol.legacy_reference: Bundled Mac CPU output retained as a separate cross-runtime diagnostic, not the primary gate

causal_policy: Exact issue-6h / issue ERA5 analyses; observed issue anchor; calendar-only future forcings. No future weather, truth or official forecast route in inference.
tracker_policy: Frozen official direct_tracker_6h_v1; no cyclogenesis; dissipation and nearby pruning disabled.
aggregation: Same frozen scorer: leads per day; days within storm; equal storms. Common three-way moving directions and pressure-valid leads; separate JMA/USA labels.
failure_policy: Fail closed for CPU, GPU errors or canary field mismatch. Missing/source-failed forecasts stay unscored. No repeated/future/nearest-date inputs.
interpretation: Development comparison: 1.2 reference is 50-member input-perturbed mean; Mini is one member, different weather source. Historical fitting-year overlap; recent 2024+ reported separately.
